stories.dek: Waivers cleared overnight. Brock Bowers is up to questionable, five guys came off the injury report, and the Matchup of the Week line holds at 17.5.
body: Waivers ran overnight, and the only real fight was for Jack Bech. Marco_Polo got him and cut Seth McGowan, who's listed Out. YourMomsDildo claimed Bech too, lost, and settled for Deshaun Watson as a backup quarterback. That's about how the season has gone for YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s: fourth in points, 4‑7, and 3 percent in Erection Projections.

Cavemanfsu dropped Kenny Gainwell on Sunday and claimed him back on Wednesday, which is either a roster plan or a very long way to say "my bad." ClaytonBigsbi swapped the Carolina defense for Washington, so Skatabooboo is doing something at 0‑11. ChuckJ10 cut Cade Otton a week after picking him up; Otton's whole PickensMyPukaHurts! career was one start and 1.8 points.

The injury report got better overnight. Drake London, Kyren Williams, Dallas Goedert, DJ Moore and Derrick Henry all cleared on Sleeper. Brock Bowers is up to questionable and sitting in the MarcusbetterLockNjigba lineup, so the Shit Show line drops a point to 22.6. Josh Jacobs and Kenneth Walker III are questionable, and Drake Maye is still Out. I'm starting C.J. Stroud.

rumors.t: Marco_Polo is said to have celebrated winning the Jack Bech claim by changing his phone wallpaper to the waiver results. Witnesses report it's still more effort than he's put into the Week 10 shotgun video.

tballsmccall has reportedly told the league he'll pick a printable team name the same day he posts the Week 11 shotgun video. Insiders note that neither has a deadline.

columnists.name: Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner
columnists.bio: Twenty years of opinions and not one of them delivered at a reasonable volume. Barry covers the league's biggest swings, and the managers who whiff on them, from a press box he keeps getting escorted out of.

columnists.bio: Three-year starter at middle linebacker and the desk's resident film-room hardass. Fitzwell grades every lineup like it's game tape, and he does not grade on a curve.

columnists.name: Oliver Klozoff
columnists.bio: Finished 14th in a 12-team league, a result the commissioner's office still can't explain. His advice is confident, carefully numbered and almost always wrong.

columnists.name: Connie Lingus
columnists.bio: Runs the desk's numbers and stands behind every conclusion she draws from them, especially the ones that don't follow. Her models are proprietary, mostly because nobody else would use them.

columns.title: Kenny Gainwell has been dropped and re-signed in the same week. Cavemanfsu, pick a lane.
columns.dek: Four straight wins, a 21.8-point line and a waiver wire used like a revolving door.
body: Let me start with the part Cavemanfsu deserves credit for. Your Mom’s Magic Dick has won four straight. It has Trey McBride, who leads every tight end in football with 87 catches, in the one week this league pays for catches. It is 6‑5 and alive at 36 percent.

Now the rest. On Sunday Cavemanfsu dropped Kenny Gainwell. On Wednesday morning, after waivers ran, Kenny Gainwell was back on the roster. Nothing about Kenny Gainwell changed in those three days. He plays for the same team. He has no injury designation. The only thing that moved was a manager's confidence.

I'm hearing Kenny Gainwell has asked Cavemanfsu for a little stability around the Your Mom’s Magic Dick locker room. Word is he's fine with the role, likes the tight end and loves the win streak, but he'd prefer to unpack his bag at least once before December.

And this week is not a week for wandering. Allen-tents & Purposes scores 140.2 a game and is a 21.8-point favorite. Denzel Boston is questionable in your lineup. The math says you need a big week and help elsewhere. So here's the advice, Cavemanfsu, from someone who has watched every one of your transactions. SET THE LINEUP ONCE AND LEAVE IT ALONE!

columns.title: Week 11 final film: every lineup graded
columns.dek: Monday night is in. The tape doesn't care about your feelings.
body: Full film session. Six games. Grades are final.

Likely Cookin That Diaper. 148.16. Kelce 25.4. Mahomes 24.96. Evans 22.9. Antonio Williams 21.2. Isaiah Likely 4.5 and Adonai Mitchell 5.0 are the misses. Grade: A. Allen-tents & Purposes. Allen 12.16, team 141.66 anyway. Grade: A.
Rome Alone. 139.94. Lamb 30.2, Jeanty 28.9. Seth McGowan 1.8 is a hole. Grade: A-minus. I Pulled My McCaff. 112.06. Keon Coleman 3.7 starts, Brian Thomas Jr. 8.8 sits. Grade: C.

PickensMyPukaHurts!. Dak 35.9. Cade Otton 1.8, picked up Wednesday, started Sunday. Won by 1.28. Grade: B. YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s. 130.62. Pat Bryant 6.2 and Elic Ayomanor 5.7. Lost by 1.28. Either one gets you the win. Grade: C-plus.

Sources say Dak Prescott has told people around the PickensMyPukaHurts! facility he wants ChuckJ10 to stop trading for receivers and start trading for offensive linemen, which is not a thing in fantasy. I'm told he likes his manager. He just doesn't understand the format.

MarcusbetterLockNjigba. 74.90. Four starters at 4.0 or less. Grade: F. You drink. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson. 76.40. Minnesota defense 0.0, Bateman 15.7 on the bench. Grade: F. You got lucky. McCallyCockin(his butt). Won by 40.26. Grade: B. Your Mom’s Magic Dick. Won, didn't cover. Grade: B-minus. Slippery Balls. 88.16, 0.00 on the bench. Grade: D. Skatabooboo. 89.54. Grade: D-plus. Effort noted.

columns.title: Six Thanksgiving lineup moves, from the only strategist who sets lineups before the turkey
columns.dek: Week 12 kicks off tonight. Your Senior Fantasy Strategist (self-appointed) has a plan for each of you, and each plan is a plan.
body: Wednesday kickoff, three games on Thanksgiving, one on Friday. Most managers will set lineups between the stuffing and the pie. Not my clients. Six moves, in order of importance.

1. YourMomsDildo: you lost the Jack Bech claim and added a backup quarterback. Start both quarterbacks. Cam Ward and a second quarterback is two quarterbacks, and two is more than one. 2. Marco_Polo: you won Jack Bech. Start him over CeeDee Lamb. New guys are motivated. Lamb has been here for weeks.

3. tballsmccall: Brock Bowers is back to questionable on Sleeper. Questionable means maybe, and maybe is a 50 percent chance of a full game. Start him at tight end and at flex. Double the maybe. 4. Shootyeah: Josh Jacobs is questionable too. You're eliminated. Start him anyway. Hope is a stat.

Word around the Rome Alone facility is that Jack Bech showed up for his first day and asked Marco_Polo about the team's culture, specifically whether the Week 10 video is ever coming. Sources say he's thrilled to be there and has already offered to hold the camera.

5. ChuckJ10: you cut Cade Otton. Pick him back up. Cavemanfsu just proved you can re-sign a guy three days later, and nobody gets to cut my sleepers. 6. Bill_Buttlicker: you're a 17.5-point dog to I Pulled My McCaff. Bench C.J. Stroud and start no quarterback. They won't see it coming. That's just strategy.

columns.title: The model on Week 12: I Pulled My McCaff is a 71 percent favorite, and the commish should be worried
columns.dek: The model said GeorigaGoocher would drink at 73 percent. GeorigaGoocher did not drink. The model is still right.
body: Inputs. I Pulled My McCaff: 1,530.28 points, 139.1 a game, a 90‑31 all-play. McCallyCockin(his butt): 1,337.36 points, 121.6 a game, 65‑56. Spread 17.5. Win probability 71 percent. Total 260.7, the highest of Week 12.

On Sunday I had GeorigaGoocher drinking the Week 11 can at 73 percent. Chase Brown scored 8.6 instead of 10.1, and tballsmccall drank instead. That's not a miss. A 27 percent outcome happening is the model working perfectly, 27 percent of the time.

Second finding. I Pulled My McCaff has scored the most points in the league and is 6‑5. Rome Alone has scored 202.82 fewer and is 7‑4. My conclusion is that points are inversely correlated with winning, and Bill_Buttlicker, at 121.6 a game, should actually be scoring less. I've told him. He hung up.

Word around the I Pulled My McCaff building is that Christian McCaffrey has asked Hing1eMcCring13berry to stop putting his name in the team name without royalties. I'm hearing he'd settle for a better locker-room vibe and fewer Sunday-night screenshots of the all-play table.
Week 12 tight end receptions payout: Trey McBride is at 7.9 catches a game. Every other healthy starting tight end in the league is under 6. I have Isaiah Likely winning it. The model has spoken.

facts: Shootyeah won in 2024 after tying for the best record at 10‑4. YourMomsDildo won in 2025 from 9‑5.
ChuckJ10 and GeorigaGoocher both went 11‑3 in 2025. Neither made the final.
ClaytonBigsbi's 54.70 in 2026 Week 7 is the lowest score in league history, 5.74 below DuvalTiliFall's 60.44 in 2025 Week 11.

Marco_Polo's Rome Alone beat ClaytonBigsbi's Skatabooboo 176.52 to 54.70 in 2026 Week 7. The 121.82-point margin is the biggest in league history, 14.66 more than the old record (107.16, Week 2 this year).
RedDevil904's 192.90 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history. His 186.82 in Week 2 is third.

ClaytonBigsbi has had the lowest score of the week four times in 2026: Weeks 4, 6, 7 and 8. Shootyeah has three (Weeks 1, 2 and 9). Bill_Buttlicker (Week 3), GeorigaGoocher (Week 5), Marco_Polo (Week 10) and tballsmccall (Week 11) have one each.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: I Pulled My McCaff vs. McCallyCockin(his butt): the biggest total of Week 12, and I'm the dog
items.dek: 260.7 projected points, two teams inside the line, and the loser gets Your Mom’s Magic Dick breathing on its neck.
body: I Pulled My McCaff scores 139.1 a week, second in the league, with a 90‑31 all-play. McCallyCockin(his butt) scores 121.6. Add them up and it's 260.7, the highest total of Week 12, 1.1 points ahead of Allen-tents & Purposes against Your Mom’s Magic Dick.

The stakes are real. I'm 7‑4 and at 87 percent. Hing1eMcCring13berry is 6‑5 and at 90 percent because the sim knows who scores more. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is 6‑5 at 36 percent and plays Allen-tents & Purposes, so whoever loses this one is the team Cavemanfsu is chasing.

The injuries wash out. I Pulled My McCaff is without Kenneth Walker III. I'm without Drake Maye, C.J. Stroud has been fine at 21.46 and 20.44, and DJ Moore and Bhayshul Tuten are questionable on Sleeper. Two points off each side; the 17.5 stays 17.5.
The pick: I Pulled My McCaff by 17.5, 71 percent. Christian McCaffrey, Malik Nabers, Nico Collins and two tight ends who catch everything. I hate this pick. It's the right pick.

items.label: Shit Show of the Week
items.title: YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s vs. MarcusbetterLockNjigba: two eliminated-in-spirit teams and the guy who owes the can
items.dek: 2 percent against 1 percent. Nobody's season is on the line, which is exactly why you should watch.
body: Not the lowest total on the board, but the only game where neither side is playing for anything. YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s is 4‑7 at 2 percent. MarcusbetterLockNjigba is 5‑6 at 1 percent after a 74.90.

YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s is a weird bad team: 1,402.22 points, fourth in the league, and a 71‑50 all-play. It just lost by 1.28. MarcusbetterLockNjigba is the opposite, 5‑6 with a 40‑81 all-play, and its last three scores average 88.69.

Brock Bowers is listed Out again and Sam LaPorta is questionable, so tballsmccall is down to whatever tight end is upright. YourMomsDildo has no injury designations on the whole roster and Bijan Robinson is back from his Week 11 bye-week absence.
The pick: YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s by 23.6, 78 percent. tballsmccall, drink the can before kickoff. It might help.

items.label: Blowie of the Week
items.title: Likely Cookin That Diaper over Skatabooboo by 38.9: the biggest spread of Week 12
items.dek: The high score of Week 11 against the team that hasn't won since last season.
body: Likely Cookin That Diaper scores 125.5 a week and just put up 148.16, the best score of Week 11. Skatabooboo scores 85.6, the worst in the league by 14.3, and is 0‑11.

DuvalTiliFall has Drake London and Kyren Williams questionable on Sleeper, which knocks a point off. It doesn't matter much when Patrick Mahomes, Travis Kelce, James Cook III and Mike Evans are all healthy, and Mahomes and Kelce play on Thanksgiving.

Stakes: Likely Cookin That Diaper is at 62 percent for a bye and 22 to be the 1 seed, so it needs this one. Skatabooboo is playing for its first win of the season and for not drinking a fifth can. The sim has ClaytonBigsbi at 39 percent to post the low score again.
The pick: Likely Cookin That Diaper by 38.9, 90 percent. ClaytonBigsbi, there's always Week 13.
